messages:
maya: FYI terraform canary plan from the pipeline is showing unexpected gpupool quota reassignments across regions. Also touches aws_kms_key.alias and an iam role name. Noticed after the provider bump.
ryan: ugh. I saw that too in the staging plan. plan wants to replace module.gpulease[...] -> module.gpulease[...] (name change). Pausing the canary apply.
infra-bot: [audit] canary apply aborted by pipeline at 1754321045. reason: "plan drift detected"
liz: my PR changed lease allocator default (regionalAffinity = true). I forgot to pin module version in production. That could move leases between regions.
maya: @liz can you confirm the PR diff? paste the quick diff if possible.
liz: diff:
```hcl
module "gpulease" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@repo/redwood/terraform//modules/gpupool?ref=v1.9.0"
  regional_affinity = true # default flipped
}
```
sam: KMS alias rename looks like the module also created a new kms alias resource name using the module name, so plan wants to replace the key alias -> that forces recreate of associated roles. That scares me for state churn.
ryan: If we let this go it'll shuffle GPUs during peak. We need a rollback strategy. Options: revert liz's PR, or add lifecycle ignore_changes for kms_alias and role_name as a short term.
maya: Agreed. Revert is safest but disruptive. Short-term patch: add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [aws_kms_alias.alias] }` in the module wrapper and pin module to v1.8.2. Then run targeted apply on canary region.
sam: I'll open a rollback PR to pin to v1.8.2 and add ignore_changes, push in 10m. @ryan can you coordinate the canary apply with me?
ryan: yep. I'll stand by. We'll run `terraform plan -target=module.gpulease -out=plan.tfout && terraform apply plan.tfout` in the canary workspace, then monitor node allocation for 30m.
infra-bot: checklist: tag=infra-oncall, run smoke tests (gpu-provisioning, node-drain), post results to #incidents if any failure.
liz: sorry team, missed the pin during the provider bump PR. Will add a changelog note and test matrix for regional_affinity.
maya: thanks. After canary passes we'll merge rollback to main and trigger gitops reconcile for remaining regions. Decide to not do a full force-replace.
sam: PR: https://git.company/pr/1029 - includes pin + ignore_changes. requesting review from @liz @maya.
ryan: ack. I'll run the canary at 10:30 PT with @sam.
maya: :thumbsup: keep slack updates short during the apply, post the `kubectl get nodes` + `kubectl describe pod` if any failures.
sam: will do. closing interim thread once apply complete.
